evidence: Carries the Validation label and refactors invalid block handling and block index tree traversals in `src/validation.cpp`.
rationale: Cleans up invalid block processing in `ActivateBestChain` to eliminate redundant block index traversals and duplicated log messages. As noted in the description citing reviews in #31405 and #31533, moving failure flag propagation and best header recalculation out of `InvalidChainFound` avoids immediately executing the failure sequence twice upon encountering an invalid block.
